task.question: Which ticker had the WORST total return over calendar year 2024? Total return is (last close in 2024 / first close in 2024) - 1. Return the ticker.

result.question: Which ticker had the WORST total return over calendar year 2024? Total return is (last close in 2024 / first close in 2024) - 1. Return the ticker.
result.cited_sql:
WITH ranked_prices AS (
  SELECT 
    i.ticker,
    p.close,
    p.date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.ticker ORDER BY p.date ASC) as rn_first,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.ticker ORDER BY p.date DESC) as rn_last
  FROM prices p
  JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id
  WHERE p.date >= '2024-01-01' AND p.date <= '2024-12-31'
),
first_last_prices AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN close END) as first_close,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN close END) as last_close
  FROM ranked_prices
  GROUP BY ticker
),
returns AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    (last_close / first_close) - 1 as total_return
  FROM first_last_prices
)
SELECT ticker, total_return
FROM returns
ORDER BY total_return ASC
LIMIT 1;
